messages:
Asha Patel: Heads-up — I'm starting a staged bring-up for model 'mini-v2-int4' on staging tonight. Goal: smoke eval + promptset ingest to catch dedupe/tokenizer drift before any canary.

Liam Chen: 👍 what's the sample size and slices?

Asha Patel: 3k total: 1.2k longform (>512 tokens), 900 multi-turn convo, 400 codegen, 500 edge-case NER/PII-ish. Will include current golden500 overlap to catch regresses.

Kate Morales: Label ops — can we get a 200-sample relabel pass for items where outputs diverge? Need hallucination + safety flags.

Ravi Singh: ops-bot created a job for relabel queue: job id 66412. Tagging as 'mini-v2-ingest-202403'.

ops-bot: Job 66412 queued. ETA labeling completion ~8h. Will auto-notify when done.

Asha Patel: Quick note on dedupe: tokenizer tweaks mean exact-hash dedupe undercounts. Proposal: run embed-fingerprint dedupe (threshold=0.86) then a light token-hash pass for exact matches.

Liam Chen: Agree. We'll run embed fingerprints with tokenizer-v2. Important: output the overlap rate vs previous dedupe set and list samples filtered.

Asha Patel: SQL snippet for the sample pull (I'll run tomorrow):
```sql
SELECT id, text FROM promptbank
WHERE created_at > '2024-02-01'
  AND domain IN ('messaging','search','code')
ORDER BY RAND()
LIMIT 3000;
```

Kate Morales: For the golden refresh — include 120 prior golden items that show diffs. Need 2 senior labelers for review / tie-break.

Ravi Singh: Canary route request: add micro-canary traffic=0.1% to mini-v2, fallback to prod-major. Will hook p99 latency + token-rate monitors. Also set batching profile to 'low-latency' for the canary.

Liam Chen: Eval sweep plan: rouge/bleu for summarization, EM for codegen, embedding-recall for retrieval prompts, plus our hallucination heuristics. We'll run on both staging and a holdout of prod traffic.

Kate Morales: Ping me when the labeling job finishes and when the sample SQL is committed so I can create relabel batches and assign senior reviewers.

Asha Patel: Timeline: ingest tomorrow 10:00 PT, label pass starts 11:00 PT, eval sweep 12:30 PT. Tagging @Kate @Liam @Ravi. Any blockers?

Liam Chen: none

Kate Morales: none — I'll be standing by for the relabel queue.

Ravi Singh: infra looks good from my side. Will confirm once canary is wired.

Asha Patel: Thanks all — I'll post a short runbook after the run with rollback criteria (quality drop >3% absolute on golden set OR hallucination rate increase >1.5x) and perf SLOs.
